data.title: Nature & Outdoors — Beginner · Lesson 1
data.subject: nature
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Let's hit the road… ¡Vamos a la carretera!
With friends by my side… Con amigos a mi lado.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's roll… Vamos
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Nature's calling us.

[Verse]
The sun is high… El sol está alto
Windows down… Ventanas abajo
The tree… El árbol
Sways gently in the breeze.
The flower… La flor
Blooms by the roadside.
Thank you… Gracias
For this perfect day.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's roll… Vamos
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Nature's calling us.

[Verse]
The river… El río
Flows with a song.
The mountain… La montaña
Stands so strong.
The sky… El cielo
Is so blue and wide.
Let's enjoy… Disfrutemos
This beautiful ride.

[Bridge]
Adventure awaits… La aventura espera
With every turn… Con cada vuelta
The world is ours… El mundo es nuestro
To learn and yearn… Para aprender y soñar.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's roll… Vamos
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
